reason.calendar-timezone-write.title: Update Tau to edit this event's time
reason.calendar-timezone-write.descripti: This event includes timezone information. Your current version only writes clock time, which would desync the actual instant across timezones.
reason.calendar-timezone-write.safety: Save was blocked and the original time is preserved. You can still edit and save the title or notes.
reason.calendar-timezone-write.explainTr: Why would saving cause a mismatch?
reason.calendar-timezone-write.explainRo: Updates only clock time while leaving the stored UTC instant unchanged.
Blocking this write preserves your original schedule until you update Tau.
reason.calendar-timezone-drag.title: Update Tau to reschedule this event
reason.calendar-timezone-drag.descriptio: This event includes timezone information and cannot be rescheduled in this version.
reason.calendar-timezone-drag.safety: Your original schedule time is intact.
